definitions.gloss: deep emotion, being deeply moved, strong impression
definitions.explanation: A powerful emotional response, typically positive, such as being moved or inspired.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{優|やさ}しさに{感激|かんげき}した。
examples.english: I was deeply moved by his kindness.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{富士山|ふじさん}を{見|み}て{感激|かんげき}した。
examples.english: I was deeply moved when I first saw Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: {お客様|おきゃくさま}からの{感激|かんげき}の{手紙|てがみ}をいただいた。
examples.english: We received an emotional letter from a customer.

notes:
{感激|かんげき} describes being profoundly moved or touched emotionally.

Common patterns:
- 〜に{感激|かんげき}する (to be moved by ~)
- {感激|かんげき}の{涙|なみだ} (tears of emotion)
- {感激|かんげき}して{泣|な}く (to cry from being moved)

Related terms:
- {感動|かんどう} (being moved - similar but slightly less intense)
- {感心|かんしん} (admiration, being impressed)
- {興奮|こうふん} (excitement)

The word combines {感|かん} (feeling) + {激|げき} (intense), suggesting intense emotion.
